title: Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities
summary: John J. Hopfield published Neural networks and physical systems with emergent collective computational abilities in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in April 1982. The paper described a model in which collective properties of many simple neuron-like components produce content-addressable memory through asynchronous parallel processing.
significance: A documented neural-network and associative-memory milestone whose original paper describes emergent collective computation and content-addressable memory in a recurrent system of neuron-like components.
organizations: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
